author: Viva La Dirt League
description:
Introducing: The Best Skit of All Time Face-Off! 
We need to determine the best skit in the entire history of Viva La Dirt League!  
Team TechTown vs Team Epic NPC Man vs Team Everything Else.   

Which will take home the title of the greatest sketch on our channel? Starting now, you have one week to submit your suggestions for the skits you think deserve the crown. We'll collect your nominations and narrow them down to the top 16 contenders.  

How do you nominate a skit? 
Comment it below this video - we’re taking nominations from the official Reddit post, Instagram, Facebook, Youtube (and the Youtube Short) and VivaPlus.
